# Requirement Sign-off Log — {PROJECT_NAME}

**Purpose:** Record who approved which version of the requirement baseline (`docs/planning/FSD.md`
+ `docs/planning/SCOPE-STATEMENT.md`), and when — so "the original agreed scope" is a lookup, not
a debate.

---

## Sign-off Method

> {e.g. "Formal sign-off — named key user + client PIC approve via email confirmation on the FSD
> PDF export" / "Self-approval — solo project, founder reviews and dates the baseline" /
> "Product Owner approval before dev sprint 1 starts"}

---

## Baseline Sign-off

| Version | Date | Document(s) Covered | Approved By (Name & Role) | Method | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | {Date} | {FSD.md v1.0, SCOPE-STATEMENT.md v1.0} | {Name, Key User / Client PIC} | {Email / Digital signature / Verbal + self-recorded} | {Initial baseline} |

**Baseline status:** Not yet signed / **Signed ✓** — development should not treat requirements as
final until this row shows a completed sign-off.

---

## Re-approval Log

*(Every material change to a signed-off requirement gets a new row — this is the requirement-
level counterpart to `docs/pm/CHANGE-LOG.md`'s general change control process)*

| Version | Date | What Changed | Approved By | Method | Impact (Scope/Timeline/Budget) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.1 | {Date} | {e.g. Added multi-currency support to FR-02} | {Name} | {Email confirmation} | {+1 week, no budget change} |

---

## Rule

A requirement is not "final" — and development should not be estimated against it with
confidence — until it appears in a signed row above. If a developer or QA is working from a
requirement that hasn't reached this log, flag it: it's still a proposal, not a baseline.
